patterns.note: Full-bleed hero sections with embedded product imagery and text overlays create an immersive, aspirational brand experience, often using natural outdoor settings.
Prominent, extended sans-serif typography is used for headlines, often in all caps, providing a bold and modern feel that contrasts with more readable, standard sans-serif body text.

A vibrant, warm orange (#ff662c) serves as the primary accent color, consistently applied to product packaging, calls to action, and key interactive elements, set against a muted, natural background palette of cream and deep ocean blues.

The main navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid background, while the initial hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a different rate than the foreground product elements and text.
The site consistently uses large, aspirational lifestyle photography to frame product displays and brand messaging, often featuring people enjoying outdoor activities.

technique_notes: The header transitions from a transparent, taller state to a solid-backed, shorter sticky bar with a slight logo size reduction as the user scrolls past the initial hero section, using CSS transitions.
The initial hero section employs a background video or image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content (product bottles, text, CTA button), creating a subtle parallax depth effect.
Content sections below the hero are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect, as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and visual flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, extended sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body) with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; buttons and product cards feature slightly rounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; hero sections are very airy, while product grids and text blocks maintain a comfortable, readable density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vibrant, almost neon orange as a core brand color, consistently applied to product packaging and calls to action, immediately grabs attention. This is powerfully contrasted with natural, aspirational beach and water imagery, creating a unique blend of modern energy and serene luxury. The custom, extended typography for the logo and main headings further reinforces this bold and unique brand identity.
